name: AI & LLM Bootcamp
description: Building Generative AI, Agents and LLM Applications Curriculum

parts.name: Week 0 - Intro to AI & LLMs
assignments: Set up OpenAI and Gemini Developer Accounts

parts.name: Week 1 - Prompt Engineering
lectures: Few-shot prompting & Chain of Thought techniques
assignments: Design robust system prompt for translation chatbot

parts.name: Week 2 - Working with LLM APIs
lectures: REST API requests vs SDK clients
Handling rate limits and backoff handling
assignments: Write node script to summarize text using GPT-4o API

parts.name: Week 4 - Vector Databases & RAG
assignments: Integrate Pinecone database to search PDF document

parts.name: Week 5 - Tool Calling & Agents
lectures: Building autonomous agents with looping feedback

parts.name: Week 6 - Model Tuning & Deployment
assignments: Deploy a fine-tuned GPT model to production environment
